description_en: Removes IP addresses from the IP address blacklist of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 删除针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo delete-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --query-type example-string --blacklist '[{"src":"198.51.XX.XX"},{"src":"198.52.XX.XX"}]' --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAutoCcBlacklist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses that you want to manage. This parameter is a JSON string. The string contains the following fields:

src: the IP address. This field is required and must be of the STRING type
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
src：String类型，必选，黑名单IP
